text:
marie: Quick heads-up — swapping Product roadmap segment earlier to accommodate EU folks. Need AV/recording check in 10m. @ops-bot can you confirm recorder + captions?
ops-bot: Recorder status: idle. @media-team please warm up encoder. :eyes: 
ben: On it, starting encoder now. obs-cli: start --scene "Allhands" --record
ben: log: [2026-03-23T16:19:12Z] OBS: recording started, no errors
paul: Note: slides for Q&A not uploaded. Sasha, can you pin the roadmap deck to #all-hands-assets?
sasha: uploading now, give me 2m
marie: Also moving "Hiring priorities" to the end; leadership Qs after roadmap. can @ceo_anna and @laura confirm?
ceo_anna: Confirmed. We'll be ready. Put the hiring Qs in the last 15m.
laura: I can handle the hiring Qs. TL;DR: prioritize infra reliability and run-time optimizations this quarter.
devon: AV note — captions were flaky last time. Ben, can you enable fallback captions (zoom captions + live transcribe) if native captions drop?
ben: yes — I added a fallback script: 
```
if !obs.check_captions():
  start_service('live-transcribe')
  enable_closed_captions()
```
ben: Will monitor. ping me if you see >3 dropped frames.
sasha: deck uploaded: https://redwood.s3/ah/roadmap_v2.pdf (version 3)
marie: @people-ops, quick ask — can we surface the updated hiring headcount slide? need numbers for Q&A.
laura: People-ops - sending updated headcount in DM, will also post to assets.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: encoder warmed, captions service attached, recorder recording -> /archives/allhands-1791234567.mp4
ben: quick obs note: CPU spikes at t=3m with webinar overlay. reducing browser sources now.
marie: Leadership Qs so far — someone asked about GA timeline for Dedicated instance autoscaling. @product_team?
ceo_anna: GA tentative Q4. Product will post detailed rollout plan post-allhands. We'll also commit to performance SLO targets.
devon: Follow-up: can we get a concise one-slide timeline for GA + Beta restrictions? that'll help answer customer questions.
paul: I'll make the slide and drop into assets in 10m.
marie: last thing — recording backup: if archive upload fails, please scp to infra-backup1:/srv/ah-archives
ben: noted, scp fallback in place.
sasha: captions working now, accuracy looks fine in preview :thumbsup:
marie: Thanks y'all. See you in 5 for pre-call mic-check. :coffee:
media-team-bot: Recording clip created: /clips/allhands/1791234567/intro-30s.mp4
laura: Post-allhands followups: 1) roadmap timeline doc 2) hiring Q slide 3) recorder postmortem if any drops. I'll create issues.
marie: perfect — assign to respective owners. closing thread in 20m.
